'''The Core''' was the planet-wide intelligence of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]], build to monitor all activities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].

==History==
In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Holodroid/Legends|holodroid]] named [[PROXY]] tried to slice into the [[Computer/Legends|computer]] system but it instead took over his body. After learning everything about wider [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], the Core believed that [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] was insufficient to bring order to chaos and that [[Droid supremacy|it was best suited for the job]]. It had PROXY lockdown the ''[[Rogue Shadow]]''{{'s}} launch codes before it could use the ship to travel the galaxy to spread its beliefs of order, organization and predictability. It used PROXY and other droids to fight [[Galen Marek|Starkiller]] so the Core could use the ''Rogue Shadow'', but he melted the Core's computer into slag, freeing PROXY from its control.
